idle.secondary_motion: restrained body sway; beer and foam counter-slosh inside the upright mug

attack.action: short heavy shoulder/body-check while preserving the beer mug
attack.secondary_motion: foam lags right on acceleration, overshoots left on impact, crosses right and damps before rest

transition.idle_to_attack: Queue attack and start it on idle bridge frame 0, 3, 5 or 7; attack frame 0 is pixel-identical to animation_base.
transition.attack_to_idle: When attack frame 7 finishes, resume idle at frame 0; both are pixel-identical to animation_base.
